messages:
anya: Heads up — thinking about a small 'minimap' in the audit panel that highlights recent actor activity and signals changes during rollouts. Tiny timeline + quick 'proof' links to the export. Thoughts?

devon: SGTM. Important we show which routing policy changed and whether fallback routing was hit (so SREs can triage).

rachel: Question — how do we handle sampling / quotas? we can't surface raw actor IDs to everyone (PII).

vishal: Default to pseudonymized actor names (actor_1234). Add an admin-only reveal button that pulls full actor info when RBAC allows. Export flow should include audit justification text.

devon: Also include a rollout tag in the payload so you can correlate a change to a canary or global rollout (e.g., rollout_id). Without that it's hard to tie events to incidents.

anya: Prototype idea: three affordances — 1) minimap dots for last 48h, 2) quick expand shows compact diff + why field, 3) download full NDJSON bundle (signed link). The minimap dot color = severity (policy vs. quota vs. actor).

liam: Can we reuse the existing proof-signing service for the downloadable bundle? want the download to be verifiable for compliance.

deploy-bot: proof-service: job 9221 finished successfully — bundle signed at https://internal.proof/service/9221 (expires in 7d) :white_check_mark:

anya: Nice — that link model works. For the compact view can we include a 1-line diff and an example affected route? e.g.,
```
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "from": "policy-B", "to": "policy-C", "tokens_quota_change": -20 }
```

rachel: +1. Also we should show telemetry counts: how many requests matched the old vs new policy in the last hour. That helps decide rollback.

vishal: Telemetry needs to be pre-aggregated; don't query raw logs for the UI. Suggest a weekly job that writes compact metrics to the audit index.

devon: UX question: should the minimap show every change or only changes that affect production traffic? We want noise reduction.

anya: Prefer a filter: default to production-impacting changes (>=100 reqs/min or flagged by rollout), with a toggle to show all changes.

liam: I'll take a quick spike to wire the signed bundle + RBAC reveal. ETA end of week.

rachel: I'll mock the minimap in Design sync tomorrow — will add a toggle for sampling thresholds. @anya please add acceptance criteria for the revealing flow (audit logging when someone clicks reveal).

anya: Will do. Acceptance criteria: 1) reveal action is recorded in audit index with actor, timestamp, reason (freeform), 2) reveal available only to roles with "audit:reveal", 3) download bundles require a signed request and expire.

vishal: Heads up — storage retention for signed bundles needs product sign-off (S3 lifecycle, TTL). Bring that to GTM.

devon: OK — once we have the spike + mock, let's schedule a 30m sync with SRE + Product to decide sampling defaults.

liam: ping me when the spike lands, I'll wire the backend hooks.

anya: Thanks all — recording this as a short RFC in the audit workspace after sync. :memo:
